sources.population: SHIP-0 (1997-2001) n=4263 and independent SHIP-Trend (2008-2012) n=4402, age 20-79, northeastern Germany. Pregnancy/missing HbA1c excluded. Whole populations include self-reported diabetes (8.0% and 10.5%). Healthy subset n=817+987 additionally excludes BMI>=30, hypertension, self-reported diabetes/medication, eGFR<=60, anemia, selected history and most medication.
sources.measurement: HbA1c by Bio-Rad Diamat HPLC, percent and mmol/mol reported; nonfasting SHIP-0, fasting SHIP-Trend. No unit conversion performed. Table 2 age models adjusted for BMI, sex-specific, with restricted cubic splines in selected strata.
